headline: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
context: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.
